meta_description:
32K likes, 87 comments - bharatzkitchen on September 25, 2026: "Ab pakka ho jayegi Shaadi 😁😁😁

Red Chicken:

First Marination :

1 Kg Chicken
2 Tbsp Ginger Garlic Paste
4 tsp Kashmiri Red Chilli Powder
1 tsp Red Chilli Powder
1/2 tsp Turmeric Powder
1/2 tsp Roasted Cumin Powder
2 tsp Coriander Powder
1 tsp Shahi Cumin Powder
1 tsp Garam Masala
1.5 tsp Salt
1 tsp Black Pepper Powder
1 Lemon Juice

For Paste:

10 Cashews
10 Almonds
3 Green Cardamom
2 Tbsp desiccated Coconut

4 Onions ( For Birista )

Second Marination :

2/3 cup Curd ( 150 gms )
100 gms Tomato Puree
Fresh Coriander Leaves
Fresh Mint Leaves
4 Green Chillies
1 Tbsp Red Chilli Sauce
1 tsp Soy Sauce
1 Tbsp Tomato Ketchup
2 Tbsp Oil
Red Food Color

For Gravy:

1 Cinnamon Stick
3 Green Cardamom
Mace
4 Cloves 
Water
Fresh Coriander Leaves

#bharatzkitchen #hyderabadi #chicken #redchicken #curry".
